cases.name: docker-up: engine up → docker=ready, exit 0, nothing started
docker-up: no docker CLI → docker=absent, exit 0 (a stack without Docker runs on)
docker-up: engine down → Docker Desktop started, the engine waited for: docker=ready (started, N s)
cases.cmd:
F={{FIX}}/du-{{SID}}; rm -rf $F; mkdir -p $F && printf '#!/bin/sh
[ -f %s/up ] || { echo "error during connect: engine stopped" >&2; exit 1; }
' $F > $F/docker && chmod +x $F/docker && printf '#!/bin/sh
touch %s/up
' $F > $F/desk && chmod +x $F/desk && DOCKER_BIN=$F/docker DOCKER_DESKTOP=$F/desk bash {{KIT}}/scripts/docker-up.sh --wait 20; echo "exit=$?"

cases.name: docker-up: the engine still down after --wait → docker=down with the CLI's error, exit 1 — the suite fails at once instead of hanging
cases.cmd:
F={{FIX}}/du-{{SID}}; rm -rf $F; mkdir -p $F && printf '#!/bin/sh
[ -f %s/up ] || { echo "error during connect: engine stopped" >&2; exit 1; }
' $F > $F/docker && chmod +x $F/docker && printf '#!/bin/sh
:
' > $F/desk && chmod +x $F/desk && DOCKER_BIN=$F/docker DOCKER_DESKTOP=$F/desk bash {{KIT}}/scripts/docker-up.sh --wait 3; echo "exit=$?"

expect.stdout:
docker=down — engine unreachable 3 s after starting Docker Desktop (error during connect: engine stopped)
exit=1

cases.name: docker-up --wait 0: Docker Desktop started, no wait — docker=starting, exit 0 (the preflight boots it during the build)
cases.cmd:
F={{FIX}}/du-{{SID}}; rm -rf $F; mkdir -p $F && printf '#!/bin/sh
[ -f %s/up ] || { echo "error during connect: engine stopped" >&2; exit 1; }
' $F > $F/docker && chmod +x $F/docker && printf '#!/bin/sh
:
' > $F/desk && chmod +x $F/desk && DOCKER_BIN=$F/docker DOCKER_DESKTOP=$F/desk bash {{KIT}}/scripts/docker-up.sh --wait 0; echo "exit=$?"

cases.name: docker-up: --wait takes seconds, anything else is a usage error
